```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r session-info-early}
Sys.time()
R.version.string
```

# Load raw data

```{r load-raw}
raw_path <- here("crypto50_combined.csv")

crypto_raw <- read_csv(raw_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names()  # -> symbol, date, open, high, low, close, adj_close, volume

glimpse(crypto_raw)
names(crypto_raw)
```

```{r provenance-log}
n_rows_raw     <- nrow(crypto_raw)
date_range_raw <- range(crypto_raw$date, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Raw row count:", n_rows_raw, "\n")
cat("Raw date range:", as.character(date_range_raw[1]), "to",
    as.character(date_range_raw[2]), "\n")
cat("Distinct symbols:", n_distinct(crypto_raw$symbol), "\n")
cat("Checksum (md5) of raw file:", tools::md5sum(raw_path), "\n")
```

# Scope to 2022-01-01 onward (pre-2022 panel is inconsistent/non-stationary)

```{r scope-filter}
crypto <- crypto_raw %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2022-01-01"))

n_rows_scoped <- nrow(crypto)

cat("Scoped row count (2022-01-01 onward):", n_rows_scoped, "\n")
cat("Rows dropped by scoping:", n_rows_raw - n_rows_scoped,
    sprintf("(%.1f%% of raw)", 100 * (n_rows_raw - n_rows_scoped) / n_rows_raw), "\n")
```

# Clean

```{r cleaning-types}
crypto <- crypto %>%
  mutate(symbol = as.factor(symbol),
         date   = as.Date(date)) %>%
  arrange(symbol, date)

skim(crypto)
```

```{r adj-close-check}
# crypto has no splits/dividends -> adj_close should == close; drop if identical
if ("adj_close" %in% names(crypto)) {
  n_diff <- sum(abs(crypto$adj_close - crypto$close) > 1e-6, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Rows where adj_close differs from close:", n_diff, "out of", nrow(crypto), "\n")

  if (n_diff == 0) {
    crypto <- crypto %>% select(-adj_close)
    cat("adj_close == close for all rows -> dropped.\n")
  } else {
    cat("adj_close differs in some rows -> keeping both, investigate.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r missingness}
crypto %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0)
```

```{r market-cap-check}
# no native market_cap column in this file -> proxy with close * volume
if (!"market_cap" %in% names(crypto)) {
  warning("No market_cap column found — using close * volume as proxy (not true market cap).")
  crypto <- crypto %>% mutate(market_cap = close * volume)
}
```

```{r outlier-check}
crypto %>%
  arrange(desc(market_cap)) %>%
  select(symbol, date, market_cap) %>%
  head(10)
```

```{r zero-price-check}
# close == 0 (or a lagged close == 0) makes log_return / daily_range blow up
# to -Inf/Inf/NaN downstream, which then poisons cor(), t.test(), and lm().
n_zero_close <- sum(crypto$close <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_zero_hl    <- sum(crypto$high <= 0 | crypto$low <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Rows with close <= 0:", n_zero_close, "\n")
cat("Rows with high <= 0 or low <= 0:", n_zero_hl, "\n")

crypto <- crypto %>%
  filter(close > 0, open > 0, high > 0, low > 0)

cat("Rows remaining after non-positive price filter:", nrow(crypto), "\n")
```

```{r derived-variables}
crypto <- crypto %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    log_return  = log(close / lag(close)),
    daily_range = (high - low) / close,
    log_volume  = log1p(volume),
    log_mcap    = log1p(market_cap)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(log_return))

n_before_finite <- nrow(crypto)

# drop any remaining non-finite log_return / daily_range (e.g. lag(close) == 0
# at a tier boundary) rather than letting Inf/NaN propagate silently
crypto <- crypto %>%
  filter(is.finite(log_return), is.finite(daily_range))

cat("Rows dropped for non-finite log_return/daily_range:",
    n_before_finite - nrow(crypto), "\n")
cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(crypto), "\n")

summary(select(crypto, log_return, daily_range, log_volume, log_mcap))
```

```{r cap-tiers}
tier_lookup <- crypto %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  summarise(mean_log_mcap = mean(log_mcap, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_log_mcap)) %>%
  mutate(cap_tier = if_else(row_number() <= 5, "Top 5", "Rest"))

crypto <- crypto %>%
  left_join(tier_lookup %>% select(symbol, cap_tier), by = "symbol") %>%
  mutate(cap_tier = factor(cap_tier, levels = c("Top 5", "Rest")))

table(crypto$cap_tier)
tier_lookup
```

# EDA

```{r eda-descriptives}
crypto %>%
  group_by(cap_tier) %>%
  summarise(
    n           = n(),
    mean_return = mean(log_return, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_return   = sd(log_return, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_range  = mean(daily_range, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_range    = sd(daily_range, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r eda-return-distribution}
ggplot(crypto, aes(x = log_return, fill = cap_tier)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 60) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Daily Log Returns by Cap Tier",
       x = "Daily log return", y = "Count", fill = "Cap tier") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r eda-volatility-boxplot}
ggplot(crypto, aes(x = cap_tier, y = daily_range, fill = cap_tier)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Daily Price Range (Volatility Proxy) by Cap Tier",
       x = NULL, y = "Daily range = (High - Low) / Close") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r eda-correlation}
crypto %>%
  select(log_return, daily_range, log_volume, log_mcap) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") %>%
  round(2)
```

```{r eda-timeseries}
crypto %>%
  filter(symbol %in% c("BTC", "ETH")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = close, colour = symbol)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "BTC vs ETH Closing Price, 2022-2026 (log scale)",
       x = NULL, y = "Close (log scale)", colour = "Symbol") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Assumption checks

```{r assumption-normality}
shapiro_sample <- crypto %>%
  slice_sample(n = min(5000, nrow(crypto)))  # Shapiro-Wilk caps at 5000 obs

shapiro.test(shapiro_sample$daily_range)
shapiro.test(shapiro_sample$log_return)
```

```{r assumption-variance}
leveneTest(daily_range ~ cap_tier, data = crypto)
```

# Inferential analysis

## Cap-tier comparison

```{r test-primary-parametric}
t.test(daily_range ~ cap_tier, data = crypto)
```

```{r test-primary-nonparametric}
wilcox.test(daily_range ~ cap_tier, data = crypto)
```

```{r test-primary-plot}
ggboxplot(crypto, x = "cap_tier", y = "daily_range", fill = "cap_tier") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test") +
  labs(title = "Volatility by Cap Tier with Test Result", x = NULL, y = "Daily range") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Regression: does volume / market cap predict volatility?

```{r model-regression}
model_vol <- lm(daily_range ~ log_volume + log_mcap, data = crypto)
summary(model_vol)
tidy(model_vol, conf.int = TRUE)
```

```{r model-diagnostics}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model_vol)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

car::vif(model_vol)
```

# Sensitivity: 2022 bear market vs 2023-2026 recovery

```{r sensitivity-period-split}
crypto <- crypto %>%
  mutate(period = if_else(date < as.Date("2023-01-01"), "2022 (bear)", "2023-2026 (recovery)"))

wilcox.test(daily_range ~ period, data = crypto)

crypto %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(mean_range = mean(daily_range), sd_range = sd(daily_range))
```
